name: Skyloft
summary: A Lahore rooftop sign-in at kite time: a post pigeon bobs as you type and puffs up to hide from your password
about: Four linked screens for a street letters app called Skyloft: sign in, create account, reset password with a 6-digit code, and a signed-in inbox. Moti the post pigeon waits on a brick parapet under a golden-hour sky full of kites; his head bobs with every letter you type, he sinks into his puffed-up neck feathers for the password and peeks with one eye when you show it. A stronger new password sends up to five kites into the sky, the reset code arrives pegged to the washing line, and he flies off with your letter when you get in.
how: Watch Moti practise the demo login on his own, then click any field to take over
Type an email: his eyes follow the caret and he bobs with each key; a known address gets a hello
Click the password field and he hides in his feathers; press the eye button and he peeks with one eye
Try a wrong password for the ruffled feathers, or turn on Caps Lock for a warning
Press Type it for me, or sign in with ayesha@skyloft.pk and basant24, to see him fly off and come back with your letters
On Create account each password rule sends up a kite (3 of 5 to join); Reset password pegs the demo code 275031 on the washing line
